causes.label: demand
causes.quote: High demand, which peaked at 9,146 MW- the highest up to that point of the summer.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Around 2,200 MW of capacity was unavailable on the evening. This included around 1,600 MW of outages, while a further 615 MW was unavailable due to generators offering less than their registered capacity.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: CleanCo's Swanbank unit removed 350 MW of capacity at 11.24 am due to a 'plant trip'. This unit is expected to return to service in September 2022. CS Energy's Callide B unit 2 removed 50 MW of capacity at 5.40 pm due to an 'emissions limit'. Alinta Energy's Braemar 3 unit failed to start at 4.53 pm removing 172 MW of capacity.

causes.label: solar_output
causes.quote: The high prices also coincided with falling solar generation in the region, which further reduced the available supply of low-priced capacity. At the times of high prices there was between 0 MW and 292 MW of solar generation available, down from 1,441 MW earlier in the day.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: A system normal constraint limited access to cheap imports from NSW at the time of the high price event in Queensland. A system normal constraint limited cheap imports from NSW to around 100 MW.

constraints_named.quote: A system normal constraint limited access to cheap imports from NSW at the time of the high price event in Queensland.

interconnectors_named.name: Queensland-New South Wales Interconnector (QNI)
interconnectors_named.quote: A system normal constraint limited imports from NSW on the Queensland-New South Wales Interconnector (QNI), further limiting Queensland's access to low-priced generation.

intervals.quote: On 20 December 2021 the wholesale price of electricity in Queensland reached $10,035/MWh, $8,602/MWh and $12,043/MWh for the 6 pm, 6.30 pm and 7 pm 30-minute periods respectively.

network_outages.quote: System normal constraints reflect network limits when there are no outages.

peak_price.quote: On 20 December 2021 the wholesale price of electricity in Queensland reached $10,035/MWh, $8,602/MWh and $12,043/MWh for the 6 pm, 6.30 pm and 7 pm 30-minute periods respectively.

rebid_set_price.quote: Rebidding capacity did not contribute to high prices.
